latest_release.name: v0.5.1
latest_release.body:
## What's New in v0.5.1

Three weeks of fixes for the desktop app: the AI works on the page you are viewing, a style button sits next to the selection, PDF export keeps the crop size on Windows, every answer shows its tokens and time, and models can think or not by a switch. It also brings the security updates of Electron 42.

### New Features

- **Style button next to the selection**: a brush button next to the selected shapes opens draw.io's format panel, for changing colors, lines and text by hand. With the chat panel hidden, a sparkle button next to it opens the panel to ask the AI (#1039)
- **Tokens, time and estimated cost under each answer**: hover the numbers for the details, such as how much input was read from the cache (#1016), and an estimated cost priced from models.dev (#762 by @Zhangxiaoyi688)
- **Thinking switch**: models whose API can turn thinking on or off get a switch in the model settings (#911 by @lq-kiren)
- **Named styles**: the model defines a style once and draws with it by name, instead of repeating the same style string on every shape (#969)
- **Models that cannot read images are marked** in the settings, with a warning when an image is attached to one (#1018)
- **MCP server card on the start screen**, with a short video, and a docs button (#990, #991, #1010)

### Improvements

- **The AI reads and draws the page you are viewing** in a multi-page diagram, instead of always the first page (#974)
- **The canvas goes with a message only when the model needs it**: earlier messages stay unchanged, so prompt caching works, and hand edits made between answers are no longer turned back (#1024)
- **Saved prompts fill the message box** instead of sending at once, so they can be changed first (#1036)
- **Pictures in the diagram reach the model as short references** instead of thousands of characters of image data (#1007)
- **Time so far while a model draws without streaming** (#1011)
- **Fixes from a user simulation**: the "changed by AI" outline fades after a few seconds, Enter sends, saved diagrams are one click away, PNG export is 2x on white with a margin, and each edit's reply says what changed (#996)
- **New app icon** (#985)
- **MiniMax**: current text models suggested (#1026 by @octo-patch)

### Bug Fixes

- **PDF export on the desktop**: Export in the PDF dialog saves the PDF directly with the diagram's own page size, so Crop no longer adds large margins and wide diagrams are no longer turned 90 degrees on Windows (#1038)
- **Shapes stay on their layer** when the AI edits a page whose other layer comes first in the file (#1037)
- **Custom data on shapes** is kept on their `<object>` wrapper (#1017)
- **Retries, stops and cut-off answers**: a retry after a tool error sends the current canvas, Stop also ends the screenshot check and the connection test, and an answer that ran out of output tokens before drawing says so with a Retry button (#987)
- **The daily limit message** no longer crashes the page (#1006)

### Security

- **Credentials**: the Test and model list endpoints refuse credentials that are not text (#1021)
- **Dependencies**: Electron 42 (#1029, after Electron 41.10.7 in #973), `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.0 (#1028), `@opennextjs/cloudflare` 1.20.2 (#1000), `proxy-addr`, `shell-quote` and `wrangler` (#971)

### MCP Server (0.4.1 to 0.4.7)

- **The preview is the web app's canvas**: version cards, compare and restore, and `get_selection` for "this box" (#984)
- **Saved sessions**, `restore_version` and the history on disk (#981); a screenshot attached to `create_new_diagram` and `edit_diagram` results on request (#983)
- **`load_diagram`** opens `.drawio.svg` files (#982) and accepts inline `xml` (#946 by @caoxiaole07); a summary of the user's hand changes, an XML reference by topic and preview options (#982); drawing guide hints and your own drawing rules (#980)
- **Install**: one-click install for VS Code and Cursor, and a Gemini CLI extension (#1015); the Windows preview opens withou

# Next AI Draw.io **Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI.** English | [中文](./docs/cn/README_CN.md) | [日本語](./docs/ja/README_JA.md) [![TrendShift](https://trendshift.io/api/badge/repositories/15449)](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0) [![Sponsor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sponsor-❤-ea4aaa)](https://github.com/sponsors/DayuanJiang) [**Live Demo**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/) · [**Docs**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/docs) · [**Gallery**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/gallery) · [**Desktop App**](https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/releases) · [**MCP Server**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/mcp)
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66b9f12f-219f-4d62-acc0-0725e6850eec Describe a diagram in a sentence and the AI draws it on a real draw.io canvas. Edit it by hand like any draw.io file, or select a few shapes and tell the AI what to change. Every AI change is a version you can compare, restore or undo, and the result exports as `.drawio`, `.png` or `.svg`. Available as a web app, a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, and an MCP server for AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code. ## Highlights **Draw** - Architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams and more from one sentence, with built-in AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes icon libraries - Connectors can carry a flowing animation - Upload a screenshot or a sketch and the AI redraws it; upload PDF, Markdown, code and other text files and get a diagram of their content **Edit** - Edit by chat: changes stream onto the canvas and the shapes the AI just changed are highlighted - Ask about a selection: select shapes on the canvas and the AI changes only those - Versions and undo: every AI change is a version card with a thumbnail; compare it with the canvas, restore it or undo it, and Ctrl+Z on the canvas also takes back an AI change in one step - It is a normal draw.io diagram: double-click to rename, drag, restyle, use several pages, and export as `.drawio`, `.png`, `.svg` or `.drawio.svg` at any time **Use** - 25 model providers, including an OpenAI-compatible preset for any other URL; enter your own API key in the browser and it stays on your machine - Models that reason show their thinking - Dark mode; the interface is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese ## Examples
Highly available web app on AWS

Prompt: Draw an AWS architecture for a highly available web app across two Availability Zones with AWS icons: Route 53, CloudFront with AWS WAF, an Application Load Balancer, ECS Fargate services in private subnets, Aurora PostgreSQL with a writer and a reader, ElastiCache for Redis, S3 for static assets, NAT gateways, and CloudWatch for monitoring.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server

 Kubernetes deployment for a web shop

Prompt: Draw a Kubernetes deployment for a web shop: an ingress, web and API deployments with their services and pods, a Redis StatefulSet with a persistent volume, a ConfigMap, a Secret, and an autoscaler on the API.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server
ER diagram of an online shop

Prompt: Draw an ER diagram for an online shop: customers, addresses, orders, order items, products, categories and payments, with primary and foreign keys and the cardinality of each relationship.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server

 BPMN expense claim process

Prompt: Draw a BPMN process for an expense claim: an employee submits it, the manager approves or rejects it, finance checks the receipts and pays, and the claim goes back to the employee when receipts are missing.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server
Transformer architecture with animated connectors

Prompt: Give me an animated connector diagram of transformer's architecture.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server

 Customer journey map of a banking app

Prompt: Draw a customer journey map for a mobile banking app across five stages (discover, sign up, first payment, everyday use, get help), with the customer's actions, touchpoints, feelings and pain points in each stage, and an opportunity for each pain point.

Model: Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code with the MCP server
More examples, each with its prompt and model, are in the **[gallery](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/gallery)**. ## Use it ### Online demo Open [next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/), nothing to install. The demo has a usage limit; click the settings icon in the chat panel and enter your own provider and API key to lift it. The key stays in your browser and is never sent to the server for storage. ### Desktop app Download the Windows, macOS or Linux installer from the [Releases page](https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/releases). ### In your AI agent (MCP) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f53a67b-ab21-4113-9fee-7fb32f9de678 Through MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol AI agents use to call outside tools), Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and others can draw draw.io diagrams directly. Add this to your client's MCP configuration: ```json { "mcpServers": { "drawio": { "command": "npx", "args": ["@next-ai-drawio/mcp-server@latest"] } } } ``` In VS Code or Cursor, one click adds it: [![Install in VS Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/VS_Code-Install_Server-0098FF?style=flat-square)](https://insiders.vscode.dev/redirect?url=vscode%3Amcp%2Finstall%3F%257B%2522name%2522%253A%2522drawio%2522%252C%2522command%2522%253A%2522npx%2522%252C%2522args%2522%253A%255B%2522%2540next-ai-drawio%252Fmcp-server%2540latest%2522%255D%257D) [![Add to Cursor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cursor-Add_Server-000000?style=flat-square)](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=drawio&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyJAbmV4dC1haS1kcmF3aW8vbWNwLXNlcnZlckBsYXRlc3QiXX0%3D) For Claude Code, one command does it (`--scope user` makes it available in every project): ```bash claude mcp add --scope user drawio -- npx @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server@latest ``` It is also a plugin in the Claude Code community marketplace (Claude Code 2.1.275 or later): ```text /plugin install next-ai-drawio --marketplace anthropics/claude-plugins-community ``` Then ask the AI for "a flowchart of user authentication with login, MFA and session management" and the diagram appears in your browser as it is drawn. The MCP server has most of the web app's drawing features: - The same drawing rules, icon libraries (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and more) and canvas as the web app: the AI's changes are outlined, one Ctrl+Z takes them back, and the AI reads the shapes you select - A screenshot tool, so the AI looks at the rendered diagram and fixes it - Version history, several pages, export as `.drawio`, `.png`, `.svg` or `.drawio.svg`, and auto-save to `~/.next-ai-drawio/`; the draw.io editor ships inside the package, so the preview works offline The [MCP server page](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/mcp) has the setup for Codex, VS Code, Cursor and other clients, every tool, and how it compares with other draw.io MCP servers. ### Compared with draw.io's built-in AI draw.io has its own Generate tool (Arrange > Insert > Generate). It runs inside draw.io on a free hosted model or your own API key, and it can change a diagram, page or selection that you attach to its chat. Next AI Draw.io sends the current canvas, including your hand edits, with every message, turns every AI change into a version you can compare or restore, and works with 25 providers, including local models through Ollama, on the demo site, in the desktop app or on your own server. ## Self-host ### Run locally ```bash git clone https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io cd next-ai-draw-io npm install cp env.example .env.local # add your provider and API key, see "Models and providers" below npm run dev ``` Open [http://localhost:6002](http://localhost:6002). ### One-click deploy | Platform | How | | --- | --- | | Tencent EdgeOne Pages | [![Deploy to EdgeOne Pages](https://cdnstatic.tencentcs.com/edgeone/pages/deploy.svg)](https://edgeone.ai/pages/new?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FDayuanJiang%2Fnext-ai-draw-io) Deploying there also gives you a [daily free quota for DeepSeek models](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edge-ai) | | Vercel | [![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FDayuanJiang%2Fnext-ai-draw-io) Set the same environment variables in the Vercel dashboard as in your `.env.local` | | Cloudflare Workers | [Cloudflare deploy guide](./docs/en/cloudflare-deploy.md) | | Docker | [Docker guide](./docs/en/docker.md) | | Offline or intranet | [Offline deployment](./docs/en/offline-deployment.md) | ### Models and providers 25 providers are supported: AWS Bedrock (default), OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter, AIHubMix, DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, SGLang, Vercel AI Gateway, Tencent EdgeOne, ByteDance Doubao, ModelScope, Zhipu GLM, Qwen, Qiniu, Kimi, MiniMax, Novita, Xiaomi MiMo, Atlas Cloud, and an OpenAI-compatible preset for any other URL (vLLM, LM Studio, a gateway). The environment variables and notes for each are in the [provider configuration guide](./docs/en/ai-providers.md). **Which model**: the task is to produce long text in a strict format (draw.io XML), so pick a capable model; small models tend to produce broken diagrams. **Several models and the admin panel**: list several model IDs in `AI_MODEL` separated by commas, or configure models from several providers with the `AI_MODELS_CONFIG` environment variable or an `ai-models.json` file, and every user can use them without a key of their own. Set `ADMIN_PASSWORD` and open `/admin` to manage models, access codes, feature switches, observability and quotas from a web page; see the [admin panel guide](./docs/en/admin-panel.md). ## Support - Questions and ideas: open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/issues) or email me[at]jiang.jp - Common problems: [FAQ](./docs/en/FAQ.md) - If the project is useful to you, consider [sponsoring](https://github.com/sponsors/DayuanJiang) to help keep the demo site running
